objective: Freeze the candle-only historical search as complete, preserve every tested model/target and result, and define the next source of genuinely new evidence without selecting another candidate from the consumed history.
acceptable_new_evidence: post-2026-08 prospective BTCUSD# candles collected after a new frozen activation date
pre-2023 BTC candles or an independent-broker dataset used as external validation with source and cost contracts
separately authorized causal data such as order flow, open interest or funding with independent timestamps and no lookahead
allowed_now: prospective data-acquisition design without selecting a live candidate
comparison of already-frozen results for explanation only
prohibited: new candle-only threshold, model, target, side, session, exit or horizon search on the same history
reuse of 2026-01 through 2026-07 as untouched evidence
promotion or rescue of any prior candidate
portfolio construction from rejected or exploratory candidates
Shadow, Discord, MT5 orders, live-ready or final signal without a new explicit authorization and frozen contract
frequency_reporting: Every event and completed-trade count remains tied to exact calendar months and monthly distribution.
